Class CardEffectInstant

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.CardEffectInstant
Direct Known Subclasses:
DiscountFood, GainFood, GainPP, GainStars, LossIfBroke, ProtectPP
public abstract class CardEffectInstant extends Object
Abstract base class for instant card effects.

An instant effect is applied immediately when its owning card's trigger phase matches the current game phase. Effects may be permanent (applied every time the trigger fires) or one-time (removed from the card after firing once). The six concrete subclasses cover food discounts, food gains, prestige point gains, star gains, PP loss protection, and PP loss on food shortage.

Jackson uses the type property in the JSON to deserialize the correct subclass.

  • Method Details

    • apply

      public void apply(Player p)
      Applies this effect to the given player without a source card context. The default implementation is a no-op; subclasses that do not need the source card may override this method instead of apply(Player, Card).
      Parameters:
      p - the player to apply the effect to; must not be null

    • apply

      public void apply(Player p, Card c)
      Applies this effect to the given player with access to the source card. The default implementation delegates to apply(Player); subclasses that require the source card should override this method.
      Parameters:
      p - the player to apply the effect to; must not be null
      c - the card that carries this effect; must not be null

    • getPpAmount

      public abstract boolean isOneTime()
